messages:
michael_releases: Heads up — v1.14.0 cutoff in ~6h. Only bugfix/cherry-picks after this. Please confirm you're pushing version bumps, changelog blurb, and docs. I'll lock branches at cutoff.
priya: quick Q — Is api-compat doc tweak okay to include in this window? it's just a small wording change.
michael_releases: Prefer docs in a separate PR but fine if it's non-behavioral. If it's code change, make it patch-only.
sam: I'll open the version bump + changelog PR now. cc @maria_docs for docs link.
ci-bot: ci-bot: build queued for sam/pr-1429 — status: running
sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1429 bump to 1.14.0 — includes changelog draft.
maria_docs: On it. Will push docs PR referencing the changelog. ETA ~30m.
lee_infra: I'm rebasing release branch to pick up latest test fixes, will force-push in ~20m — heads up for anyone with open PRs.
qa_tester: Can we run a smoke after merge? I can kick off the suite against staging once PR is in.
security_team_bot: security-scan: latest merge-base scan passed. No critical findings.
michael_releases: Great. Once PR is merged, please add the `release-ready` label. I'll do final sign-off at -1h before cutoff.
priya: signing off on docs (pr #1430) :white_check_mark:
lee_infra: infra + branch side OK from me :+1:
sam: merged version bump and changelog, added `release-ready` label. CI green.
ci-bot: ci-bot: all checks passed :white_check_mark:
qa_tester: Smoke run kicked — staging job: https://staging.redwood.ai/smoke/987 — will report results in ~10m.
maria_docs: Docs PR merged (small API wording tweak). Linked from changelog.
michael_releases: Thanks — Security, QA, Docs, Infra — if all good I'll cut at cutoff and tag. If anything blocks, ping here.
security_team_bot: security-team: quick thumbs — no block from security.
qa_tester: smoke status: PASS. No regressions found. :tada:
michael_releases: Cutoff in 10m — final lock incoming. Tagging release in 5.
sam: copy, standing by.
